name: Pullup
description: A pullup is pulling the body up on a bar with the arms. Hang from the bar, pull up until the chin is over the bar, then lower back down.

items.content: Hands on the bar, about shoulder width apart
Core braced, glutes squeezed, legs together
Elbows driven down toward the ribs

stages.name: Eccentric
stages.description: Dead hang from the bar, arms straight, body straight.

stages.name: Concentric
stages.description: Chin over the bar, elbows bent, body straight.
